messages:
Anna (Design): Quick design review — collapsing rows in the dashboard grid feels cramped at 8px vertical spacing. Screenshot + notes: https://img.redwood.local/snap/ctx-1234.png
Kevin (Frontend): I noticed the focus ring disappears on collapsed rows when you tab through. prob a CSS specificity issue.
Sophie (PM): Users asked for more density but still need to hit targets for keyboard users. can we do 10px for compact mode?
Tyler (Dev): 10px seems fine. also the copy on the collapse affordance reads 'Show more' which is ambiguous when it's a row expander. maybe 'Expand row' / 'Collapse row' aria-label would be clearer.
Anna (Design): +1 on explicit copy. Also thinking of a subtle chevron rotation and adding aria-expanded to the button.
a11y-bot: Reminder: interactive targets must be >= 44x44px for touch. current collapsed chevron width ~36px.
Kevin (Frontend): For the focus bug, this patch fixes it:
```
.row-expander:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--interactive-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }
.row-collapsed .content { padding-top: 10px; padding-bottom: 10px; }
```
I'll run visual tests after merge.
Sophie (PM): How does this affect card density on narrow screens? We shouldn't push content below visual fold.
Anna (Design): On narrow screens we should switch to single-line compact rows (reduce meta chips) and keep 10px vertical padding. I'll update tokens: spacing.xs -> 8 for tight mode, spacing.s -> 10 for compact.
Tyler (Dev): Are we changing token names? prefer not to rename tokens mid-release. maybe map compact -> spacing.override instead of renaming.
Anna (Design): Good point. I'll keep token names but add a compact alias in the component theme.
Kevin (Frontend): Also found a visual regression: toast anchored to top-right overlaps the header when rows are expanded rapidly. Suggest adding z-index: 900 for header or moving toast anchor down 8px.

Tyler (Dev): moving toast anchor by 8px sounds less risky. we already have toast offset token (toast.offsetTop). bumping that in compact mode should do it.
Anna (Design): Copy tweak for the expander: change visible label to nothing (icon-only) but add visually-hidden text: "Expand row" / "Collapse row". Keep same tooltip: "Expand row to view details".
Sophie (PM): Tagging release constraints: target for this small UX fix in next patch (release-3.2.1). no breaking token renames.
Kevin (Frontend): I'll open PR with code + unit tests + a11y annotations. Will include screenshots and Percy diffs.
Anna (Design): Thanks — also adding a quick accessibility checklist to the PR description: focus order, aria-expanded, hit target, screenreader text, contrast.
Tyler (Dev): If anyone's free, can we pair on the Percy snapshots after CI? want to ensure we didn't accidentally change table row height in other contexts.
Sophie (PM): I'll help schedule a quick pairing slot at 11:15.
Anna (Design): Awesome. Small follow-up: revisit spacing tokens in the design token doc so compact mode is documented. will post update there. :sparkles:
